annotations.title: Send the link to everyone, and get the tap that puts it in a group chat.

description: Emails the invitation once to every person added with an address, and returns a tap that opens WhatsApp, a text or a mail draft with the message and the link already written, for the family group and for anyone with no address. Nobody gets the invitation twice, and each caller has a daily limit on emails.

also_email.description: false returns the taps and sends nothing. Without it, the invitation is emailed.
